accrual.notes: Each system's completed rollouts are ranked from lowest to highest realized cost (or tokens, or steps). Moving right along a curve adds the next-ranked rollout: x accumulates its resource divided by all N valid rollouts and y accumulates its final solve divided by N, so every curve ends at the system's mean resource per rollout and its success rate; the Cost endpoints are exactly the points on the performance-cost Pareto frontier above (the cost frontier). Color = model, endpoint marker = harness; a filled endpoint marks a system on the cost frontier, an open one a dominated system, and an open endpoint on a dotted curve a system whose cost-frontier status is unavailable. The opening animation grows every curve at the same spend, its endpoint marker riding the tip, until the most expensive drawn curve has reached its end; every curve starts faint and a system turns full color the moment it takes the lead of the drawn frontier, staying so from then on. Curves are drawn as a centered moving average over 9 consecutive ranked thresholds (the window shrinks symmetrically at the ends, so both endpoints are exact and monotonicity is preserved); hover shows the exact ranked prefix behind each drawn point. The shaded band follows the drawn (smoothed) curves; its statistics are computed on the exact ranked steps: 'at equal spend' averages the vertical gap over the budgets both systems actually spent, and 'to reach the same success rate' averages the extra spend needed to match each resolved level both systems reached. Final outcomes are observed only at completion, so these are retrospective accounting curves, not time-to-correct or budget-response curves. Steps keep harness-defined units and are not comparable across harnesses. Systems with incomplete or non-reconciling telemetry are withheld, never zero-imputed. When one system's endpoint is more than 3× the next system's, the axis stops at that next system and the runaway curve leaves the frame at the right edge, where an arrowhead and a label give its exact endpoint (faint when the system is not highlighted); the table lists every exact endpoint.
